messages.author: ad275245ba393d96
messages.subject: Re: [gur-ugr] DOI para RPubs
parts:
Pregunté ayer a los de Rstudio. Copio su respuesta.

Ian Pylvainen (RStudio Support)

Apr 16, 11:03

Hi José,

We don't assign DOIs on Rpubs. If you want to have pointers to the location, it would probably be better to be hosting the document on your own domain. If you like, you could still redirect to us on Rpubs, but it is probably smarter for the permanent location address to be owned by you.

Hope this is helpful.

Best,
Ian
